new_in_release.expect: H1 2026 EBIT: the first operating number of the year. H1 is seasonally loss-making (H1 2025 -2.96m). With +2.55m of revenue against the announced reinvestment (six enterprise hires, VP channel, PRM tools, Malizen team) my own estimate is about -1.0 to -2.0m, better than last year but still a loss; no sourced H1 bar exists.
H1 FCF likely negative again on seasonality (H1 2025 -1.5m); 30 June cash will NOT include the July EUR 25m financing. Down-side risk to the reading if the burn is larger than last year.
Most likely a fourth reiteration of positive FY2026 EBIT and FCF; no numeric revenue guide exists to change. A cut to the EBIT target would be the large-move tail (down); no evidence points to one.

Possible M&A commentary: the July financing is explicitly a 'levier ... en vue de constituer une plate-forme européenne de consolidation'; an acquisition announced with the results is possible, unknown.

findings.why_not_priced: The seasonality is public, so the existence of an H1 loss is priced; what is not is its size, because neither broker's H1 split is public (two analysts, no sourced H1 bar) and the stock has drifted up 7% over 20 sessions into the print rather than de-rating the way it would if a wide H1 loss were expected. Sized small because the improvement versus last year (+2.55m of revenue) cuts the other way and is my own inference, not a document.

findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Top-line prints sold twice in a row: Q1 2026 -4.45% (17 Apr 2026, 'marginalement inférieur' to Oddo), H1 2026 revenue -3.29% (17 Jul 2026).
findings.original_quote: Oddo BHF ajuste par prudence son scénario 2026 (chiffre d'affaires à 49.3 MEUR, en croissance organique de 21% contre 24,6%; EBIT à 3 MEUR contre 4,5 MEUR, soit une marge de 6%). -- 'Oddo BHF prudently adjusts its 2026 scenario (revenue EUR 49.3m, 21% organic growth vs 24.6%; EBIT EUR 3m vs 4.5m, a 6% margin).'
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the H1 revenue has been public since 16 July and the stock fell 3.3% on it, so a broker cut has probably already happened. What remains is that the release's H2 commentary could make the FY revenue and EBIT gap explicit; sized near zero because the company's own guide (recurring-revenue growth, recurring +24.1% in H1) is intact.

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly negative, against a +7% 20-day run-up and a priced lean of -0.35 that is the run-up alone; that agrees with the free control rather than beating it, so the size stays small.
language_note: The issuer's own French release carried the date of the event ('Résultats semestriel 2026, le 8 octobre 2026') and the full H1 revenue tables; the English twin exists but no English press carried the date.

The broker numbers (Oddo BHF FY2026 EUR 49.3m revenue / EUR 3m EBIT, TP 31; TP ICAP Midcap TP 32 and top-line trim) exist only in French Zonebourse/Boursier copy mirrored on tradingsat.com and boursedirect.fr.
The KKR take-private rumour (La Lettre) was found only in French copy.
The French calendar (ABC Bourse) is the only source found giving 'Après clôture' for 8 October, which settles the session as amc.
The CEO holding's share sales were found only on a French aggregator.
lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the top-line deceleration finding was cut from -0.5 to -0.2, since H1 revenue has been public since 16 July and the stock already fell 3.3% on it.

'You were right about the number and too small about the move' and 'the tail is intact': abs_move_pct raised from 5.0 to 5.5 for a two-analyst, $112k/day name whose last H1-results day moved 9%; the selling of recent prints moves p_up (45), not the size.
'Cash can outweigh a raised guide': H1 FCF (seasonally negative, H1 2025 -1.5m) folded into finding 1 and named in new_in_release rather than added as a separate finding.
'Your own session check ... open with the verdict': session_check opens with amc and cites the calendar and the AMF timestamps.
